- Parent: draft #226 at `b2b695f66fc8dfc907f2b9a493b39bd4d4109570`; task #231, WBS2/P1.0 → WBS2.1/P1.1. **Dependent draft targeting the parent branch**, not main.
- The positive-node inspector explicitly holds zero endpoints as unqualified; this does not declare vendor-invalid data. Dormant residue is UNKNOWN, with owner/pointer/slot/raw cards and byte spans. Other populated auxiliary families remain unqualified beyond pointer bounds.
- Six existing mirrored files changed; protected parser/writer/other engines untouched. One new actual-app DOM/physical-splice test; native pre-edit backups and history-independent patches preserved.
- **SELF_ASSESSED:** required17/17; focused11/11; bounded Geometry9/9. Complete VNext121 PASS/1 FAIL versus predecessor110/1 and base94/1: the same untouched branch-scope failure at test line85. Both public V14 fixtures retain exact hashes/bytes; six source/served pairs match.
- Actual browser could not launch (Chrome executable unavailable); Windows, protected original and licensed CAESAR II NOT_RUN. Fresh non-author #228 review is still required. No property writer, merge/deploy/release or P2 authority.

Final candidate: `7f5dc773ac7bb08544d086be734e4337295088a0`; tested code commit `bb479a851bb2c9b92918352be64967ef86c89bf5` (report-only allocation follows). All eight final product files and all22 payload files were actually retrieved/read back. [Coordinator receipt](https://github.com/reallakshman19/Common/blob/ddec22b0d23e3eefb129ef0a5e84480ca4efb58e/relay/AGENT_WORK/CIIFR-Node/CIIFR-NODE-WBS-P0-20261028/returns/P1-R0-REPAIR-R1-20261029/COORDINATOR_READBACK.json) preserves that observation; independent recipient receipt remains NOT_RUN. **GATE_R0 HOLD; do not merge.**
